jobs.description: What will you do?As an Operator within the extrusion department, you play an important role in the production of high-quality aluminium profiles. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that the production process runs smoothly, safely, and efficiently. Thanks to your attention to detail and hands-on approach, the highest quality standards are consistently achieved.Your responsibilities• Setting up, adjusting, and operating sawing equipment to cut aluminium profiles accurately to the required dimensions.• Operating straightening machines to ensure profiles meet quality and specification requirements.• Performing quality inspections and checking dimensions, straightness, surface quality, and possible defects.• Installing, changing, and maintaining dies while supporting the extrusion process.• Monitoring production output and reporting any deviations, defects, or technical issues.• Contributing to a safe, organized, and efficient working environment.Working hoursYou will start in a two-shift schedule during your training period:• 06:30 - 15:00• 14:30 - 23:30After your training, you will move into a three-shift rotation:• 07:00 - 15:00• 15:00 - 23:00• 23:00 - 07:00Work schedules are communicated well in advance, giving you plenty of time to plan your personal life. Where possible, shift swaps can be arranged in consultation with colleagues. Employees travelling by public transport can also receive support in finding suitable commuting solutions.This is a varied and hands-on position where you will combine technical work, quality control, and teamwork while contributing to the production of aluminium profiles used in industries around the world.Functie-eisen:What do you bring?• You have a good command of Dutch and/or English and can communicate effectively with colleagues in a production environment.• You have technical knowledge or experience gained through education, training, or hands-on work within manufacturing, engineering, or production.

jobs.occupation: Maintenance Technician – Relocate from Portugal to the Netherlands
jobs.description: Are you a hands-on technician who likes fixing things, solving technical problems and working with machines? Would you also like to use your technical skills in an industry that gives plastic a second life? We are looking for an All-round Maintenance Technician to join the technical team. What will you do? You will be part of the technical maintenance team and help keep the recycling plant running safely and reliably. Your work can include: Preventive and corrective maintenance Finding and solving technical problems Mechanical repairs Basic electrical troubleshooting Maintenance on pumps, motors, valves and production equipment Replacing and repairing mechanical components Helping when there is a breakdown Working together with production operators and other technicians Improving the reliability of machines and installations It is a hands-on technical job with plenty of variety. Arbeidsvoorwaarden We want to make the move to the Netherlands worthwhile. You can expect: A Dutch employment contract A competitive salary based on your experience 3200 - 4200 euro gross, per month Additional benefits according to the Dutch employment package A stable, full-time position in an international industrial company Support with your relocation to the Netherlands Help with finding accommodation and arranging practical matters Opportunities to learn, develop and grow within the technical team Functie-eisen You could be a good match if you: Have a background in mechanics, electromechanics, mechatronics, electricity or industrial maintenance Have experience as a maintenance technician, mechanic, electromechanical technician or similar Enjoy practical technical work Have some knowledge of both mechanical and electrical systems Are comfortable working in an industrial environment Can communicate in English Are interested in moving to the Netherlands You don't need to know everything. If you are technically minded, like working with your hands and are willing to learn, we would like ttalk to you. Hier kom je te werken The factory is focused on plastic recycling. Used PET bottles are collected, sorted, cleaned and processed into high-quality recycled plastic material. This material can then be used again for new bottles, packaging, fibres and other products. Instead of plastic becoming waste, the goal is to bring it back into the production cycle. For you as a technician, this means working in a real industrial environment with machinery, production lines, pumps, motors and technical installations that need to keep running every day. Relocation to the Netherlands The position is based in the eastern part of the Netherlands. Moving to another country is a big step, so we help you with the practical side of your relocation. We can support you with: Relocation from Portugal to the Netherlands Finding accommodation Registration and administration Practical arrangements before your move Support after you arrive
